notes.title: Oculus Touch update, a new diorama & Blocked In is now free!
notes.content:
Heya everyone! 

It's exactly a year ago that Marchland was released. Time flies! To celebrate this anniversary, I've fixed some issues and made the app compatible with Oculus Touch. The third view also slightly changed. Let me know if you like it.  

The last year I've been working hard on my new diorama  [b]'Diorama No.4 : The Fernweh opera'[/b] in which you will visit an impossible intergalactic opera, performed by a 30 ft opera singer and explore her dressing room. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22252996/d042b58f1ee3bea442fba7cce7c9e9321c76c4a3.jpg[/img]

The first version was showcased at the Frankfurter Buchmesse last year and it is a sequel to [b]'Diorama No.2 : Der Grosse Gottlieb'[/b]. The Opera has been written by poet Maud Vanhauwaert and composed by Misha Velthuis and performed by opera singer: Annina Gieré. This will also be the first character driven diorama. 

To stay up to date, try out future demos or see sneak peeks of things to come, check out my facebook site: http://www.facebook.com/shoeboxdiorama. 

I'm a one man operation so my updates are a bit slow, but I hope to see everyone around! 
 
All the best, 
Daniel Ernst

PS [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/431390/] Diorama No.1 : Blocked In  [/url] is now free!

notes.title: Updates : "Oculus implementation and other fun stuff"
notes.content:

[list]

    [*][ ] [b]Oculus Rift Support[/b] - CV1 update
    [*][ ] [b]Additional view [/b]

    [*][ ] [b]Optimisation and other tweaks[/b]

Other Changes:

[/list]
